caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic cup placed within a square outlined frame on a neutral, beige background. The cup is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance with smooth shading and subtle highlights that suggest its reflective surface. The cup is slightly conical, wider at the top and narrowing toward the base, and it has horizontal bands around its body. The rim of the cup features a decorative dotted pattern, and the base is broad and flat, extending outward from the body. The drawing is centered within the outlined square, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right corner outside the square. The entire composition has an organized and clean arrangement, with no additional objects present.
title: Pewter Cup
